description: This file defines custom metrics API types for Kubernetes, including MetricIdentifier, MetricValue, MetricValueList, and MetricListOptions, along with associated constants and import statements.

classes.name: MetricIdentifier
classes.description: Identifies a metric by name and optional label selector.

classes.name: MetricValueList
classes.description: Represents a list of metric values for a set of objects.

classes.name: MetricValue
classes.description: Represents the value of a specific metric for an object, including timestamp and window.

classes.name: MetricListOptions
classes.description: Options to filter and select metrics based on label selectors.

methods.name: deepcopy-gen
methods.description: Interface annotation for code generation to create deep copy methods for runtime objects.
